description:
Step 2 of attaching artwork: report the completed PUT to register the file.

Call after PUTting the bytes to the presigned `url`. `object_key` is the
one `order_request_artwork_upload` returned; `size` is the byte count you
PUT. The filename and content type are the ones you presigned with.
Marks the line covered, clears the payment refusal, and arms prepress,
so the order can then reach page mapping and a payment link. Refused with
`ItemDesignAttachedError` when the item of a multi-item order already holds
an attached design, which is what prints.
name: order_confirm_artwork_upload

order_id.description: None until the order has a payment link.

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).

title: Confirm an artwork upload
